text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, heading to the cafeteria,
I found students playing Reversi—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Fufu, looks like you have nowhere left to play a piece. That means it's my turn again――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, keep playing and it's checkmate in two moves.
I win!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, not bad at all.
You might just make it pretty far
in tomorrow's Reversi tournament, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...Wait, you're entering too?
Fufu, you'd better pray you don't run into me♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haha, thanks for the advice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...To be shut out so completely.
choice_data_list: (Should I try to cheer her up?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, I quickly realized the meaning behind that smile.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why meeee?!
Why do I have to――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Why am I on the defensive when I was the one attacking?"
――The answer is simple.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's because I can see right through your hand.
Thanks to our sparring match yesterday, that is.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: N-No, that can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An orthodox yet ferocious offensive.
That's your signature fighting style.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still, once you know the trick, there's nothing to fear.
You just let them attack and lure them into the mire.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Appreciate the valuable info.
So, what's the plan?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You'll be checkmated in two moves.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I concede defeat...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding that momentum, Rulership
went on to win the Reversi tournament.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, aren't you that trainer who was watching so intently?
So, how was my match?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It means the game had already begun,
far beyond the boundaries of the 8x8 board.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about having a bout with me?
I haven't had nearly enough yet!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about having a bout with me?
I haven't had nearly enough yet!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, let me give you fair warning first.
If you're scheming to steal my fighting style, give it up.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Without giving away my hand,
I'll turn this into a completely one-sided game!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A pity. But a wise choice.
If you don't fight, you can't lose.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yet at the same time, you will never taste victory.
Never knowing the joy of winning
is a genuine shame.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if you change your mind.
I'll gladly accept.
